reference: Unaugmented receiver recording, including original noise/channel/pilots; not noise-free transmitter truth
evidence_limit: Host files validate saved UART provenance, not cryptographic FPGA image readback. Mixed-band/midpoint spectra do not certify isolated 20 dB / 1 dB acceptance or BER.

status.note: Observed status maxima; absent fields are null. Row counts are not active-time estimates.

definitions.error_reduction_db: 20log10(norm(input-clean)/norm(output-clean)); common aligned interval; no gain fitting; zero errors return null with a reason
definitions.interferer_attenuation: Offline configured fixed source frequency +/- one FFT bin; same-window Hann mixed input/output band power ratio, signed dB; >=80ms, no source edges/changes and >4 bins from other active tones
definitions.interferer_limit: Total mixed-band attenuation includes target and noise. It is not isolated per-source interference attenuation and cannot certify a 20dB requirement. Source labels are used only for offline display.
definitions.midpoint: Offline configured-frequency connected groups with <=750Hz neighbor gaps and exactly two enabled members; not FPGA grouping. Hann output/reference power ratio in midpoint +/- one FFT bin; signed dB
definitions.midpoint_limit: Mixed output includes residual interferers and noise. This is not isolated target loss, not online grouping, and cannot certify the <=1 dB protection requirement.
